protocol.sampling: Within each source region use the same seeded ID permutation prefix, taking max(1, floor(fraction * n)). Both regressors use the same six source regions and photos.
protocol.joint_rmse: Square root of the mean squared forecast error over both experts and all photos, after clipping expected distances to zero from below.
protocol.pooling: Pooled training metrics count each in-fold training exposure. Held photos enter once. Macro averages the seven region metrics equally, excluding undefined closer accuracies.
protocol.routing: Choose the smaller expected distance; predicted ties choose T5. Closer accuracy is a fraction excluding exact observed-error ties. Geographic distance metrics include all photos.
